implementation: Used as supplied in population-weighted risk and retained in detailed outputs.
Retained under its source field name for reporting and quality control.
BSR-level 0-to-1 aggregate used as supplied in overall limiting-factor impact.
Source 1-to-5 score already mapped to 0.1-to-1 in the CSV.
Rank 1-to-15 already mapped to 1.0-to-0.1 in the CSV.
Uses the higher adult or juvenile migration value without counting migration twice.
Raw directness multiplied by frequency; no D/I/N replacement.
Fixed theoretical upper bound of 1.0 for LS_corrected_score; QC fails rather than deriving the bound from observed scores.
Raw impact and risk are divided by common BSR-level theoretical maxima so detailed normalized contributions still sum to normalized BSR totals.
Raw action scores are divided by maxima based on the complete LFAT crosswalk so normalized action contributions still sum to normalized overall action scores.
The fish-use and limiting-factor files use the same CC1/CC2/etc. identifiers.
